body.name: Certified finite legality procedure
body.construction: Generate the architecture list, expand every coordinate of \(\Phi_T\) and every \(Z_e\) as a rational polynomial, introduce \(t\) through \(\Phi_T(p_T)_n-t\Phi_T(p_T)_d=0\), and form \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\) as the finite disjunction over \(T\) and \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\). Quantifier elimination partitions the \(t\)-line, reports INFEASIBLE or isolates the algebraic infimum and supremum of the bounded finite image, and tests \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\) at each isolated closure endpoint. Cylindrical algebraic decomposition returns \(\mathsf{Cert}(t)\): either an algebraic legal response witness, or sign-invariant cells proving each architecture branch empty and separating an illegal closure endpoint from every enumerated legal lift.
